name: van-thang-mobile

scripts.eas:ios: node scripts/clean-native.mjs && eas build -p ios --profile production
scripts.eas:android: node scripts/clean-native.mjs && eas build -p android --profile production
scripts.eas:all: node scripts/clean-native.mjs && eas build -p all --profile production
scripts.eas:preview: node scripts/clean-native.mjs && eas build -p all --profile preview
scripts.eas:ios:preview: node scripts/clean-native.mjs && eas build -p ios --profile preview
scripts.eas:android:preview: node scripts/clean-native.mjs && eas build -p android --profile preview
scripts.eas:simulator: node scripts/clean-native.mjs && eas build -p ios --profile simulator

//: Every expo-* version here is the one Expo SDK 57 bundles (bundledNativeModules.json). Do not bump them by hand — run `npx expo install --fix`, which is the only thing that knows what this SDK was tested against. react-native-webview is 13.16.1 for the same reason: 14.x exists on npm, but 13.16.1 is what SDK 57 pins.
